_note: Real reviews copied from the USA Liquidation Google listing on 2026-11-10. Rating/count from the same page. The first 3 show on the home page.

reviews.name: Linda L.
reviews.text: I went to Ashley's and their dining tables were beyond my small budget. So I walked in and there sat a dining table, exactly what I hoped for — something beautiful and affordable… I also paid less than half of what other furniture stores sell. They delivered furniture ASAP and wrapped the chairs to keep from the small drizzling rain.

reviews.name: Rawan A.
reviews.text: Came here for outdoor furniture and ended up buying the perfect set for us at fraction of the price! The owners are friendly and helpful. Happy with our purchases.

reviews.name: T. Rice
reviews.text: Stopped in to look at advertised patio furniture. Was able to buy it and staff loaded and tied down everything. Super easy to deal with and I recommend you shop them first. Lots of different things for sale.

reviews.name: Eric P.
reviews.text: Find a great variety of products, including sofa sectionals, brand name appliances and dining tables. All at discounted prices. Financing is easy and the staff is knowledgeable.

reviews.name: Christopher W.
reviews.text: They run an honest customer service based business and can't recommend them enough for how they operate.
